meta.approvalScope: parameterized templates only; no account scan, role mutation, apply or live inference

inputs.userGoal: 快速生成sample数据，部署环境，运行跑分，输出可视化测试结果
subGoals: One ephemeral CPU worker; synthetic inputs; no production HA or GPU requirement
Separate trusted inference identity from untrusted task execution
Explicit cost, permission, egress and evidence-export gates before live operations

reasoning.tradeoffs: Managed Run Command is the management channel

properties.publicIp: off by default; outbound-only option requires explicit approval

reasoning.whyChosen: Connect one worker to its approved subnet
reasoning.tradeoffs: Default outbound access is not assumed

properties.authentication: SSH public key; no exposed SSH port

reasoning.tradeoffs: Single disposable worker; no HA claim

reasoning.whyChosen: Durable evidence and atomic broker run ledger
reasoning.tradeoffs: LRS and authenticated public endpoint only for synthetic data; verified export before deletion
Separate deployment-scope inference role must be approved

properties.logs: durable run evidence; no default Log Analytics workspace

reasoning.tradeoffs: Synthetic-only public TLS ingress; no private/customer-data or production SLA claim

reasoning.whyChosen: Bind inference to deployment and conserved budget
reasoning.tradeoffs: Lease/conditional-write accounting is required even with one replica

overallReasoning.summary: User-approved local/cloud benchmark design with separated identity and execution planes.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: No tenant insights were scanned because environment binding was explicitly deferred. No GPU/AKS/ACR/Bastion/default HA/Key Vault/Log Analytics resources: original synthetic tasks, ephemeral single worker and constrained scope. A secure deployment parameter configures broker signing secret; no keys in traces or parameter examples. Private container is not private endpoint. Optional outbound IP is disabled, denies inbound and requires separate explicit approval; otherwise choose an approved existing egress path. Actual subscription, region, capacity, roles, model API, prices and cloud lifecycle watchdog remain gates.

plan.validation: Local Bicep build and offline budget/export/lifecycle tests verified; actual Docker image, what-if, account preflight, identity, network, model calls and apply unexecuted.
